posts.title: A Forgotten Governor Springs Back to Life
posts.description: Several friends forwarded the same Instagram reel to me last week, all asking if I knew anything about it. It was from Shapero Rare Books, based in Mayfair, London. posts.title: The State of Statues
posts.description: Our State may have evolved politically over several decades on a plank of rationalism that included protests against all forms of idolatry. But putting up statues has always been considered outside this principle. The end result is that we are a state of statues, with one in practically every open space and street corner.
